sections.title: The Present Tense
sections.content: You have been using this since Lesson 1 — here is the system behind it. Every Spanish verb ends in -ar, -er or -ir. Take that ending off, and what is left is the stem: trabajar → trabaj-, leer → le-, vivir → viv-. Then add the set of endings that belongs to the group. Regular verbs never do anything else, and most verbs are regular.

items.spanish: Trabajo por la mañana y estudio español por la tarde.
items.english: I work in the morning and study Spanish in the afternoon.

items.spanish: Lauren siempre desayuna antes de trabajar.
items.english: Lauren always has breakfast before working.

items.spanish: Por la noche leemos historias en español.
items.english: In the evening we read stories in Spanish.

items.spanish: Todos los días practicamos un poco.
items.english: Every day we practise a little.

sections.content: The -er and -ir endings are the same except in nosotros and vosotros: 'leemos' but 'vivimos'. Learn one set and you have most of the other.

sections.topic: the present tense of regular verbs
